game: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse

packages.name: Castle of Illusion activation 32x9 (gameplay-changing)
packages.author: segarecomp-patches contributors
packages.gameplay: Changed: layout objects are activated earlier and farther away for 32:9 (widescreen scenery and actors are presentation only; user-invoked Practice+ restores power)
packages.supported_scope: Castle of Illusion widescreen for 32:9 with authored scenery in the verified scrolling scenes, actors beside the picture, a gameplay-changing early object activation sized for 32:9, and the user-invoked Practice+ power restore.
limitations: Applies only to the one image this entry lists (USA, Europe); any other image is refused by digest.

Gameplay-changing: objects farther from the camera exist earlier than in the original, so enemy contact and damage events can differ (damage-event counts differed on some stages in the maintainers' deterministic-route measurement). Items, collisions, RNG effects, boss completion and natural level progression were not verified.
Authored scenery covers the verified scrolling scenes only; menus, cutscenes, level loads and any other layout use the host's generic extension.
Needs a segarecomp build that can install schema 3 / native ABI 2 packages (v0.9.0 or later). See docs/installation.md.
